notes: Arizona's All-State choral programs are run by Arizona Choral Educators (ACE), the choral constituent organization of the Arizona Music Educators Association (AMEA, azmea.org), a NAfME state affiliate. Registration for all ACE events except the State Choral Festival goes through the AMEA website; the AzACDA-run State Choral Festival is a separate non-audition event. IMPORTANT ON DATING: AMEA's own 'High School All-State Festival of Performance' page was badly stale at retrieval (forms and deadlines dated 2021), and the ACE calendar page returned 'App Unavailable'. ACE's Events page describes the audition and festival timing only generically (regional auditions end of January, All-State auditions in March, two-day festivals) with no calendar dates. The only 2026-27 dates confirmed on an AMEA source were ACE registration-open dates in August 2026. No 2026-27 audition dates, deadlines, fees, clinicians, or performance repertoire were published publicly; much of it appears to sit behind the AMEA member login. The 2027 AMEA In-Service Conference is January 29-30, 2027. Structural facts below (ensemble sizes, audition format, selection pipeline) come from ACE's evergreen program descriptions, not from a 2026-27 calendar.

organization.name: Arizona Choral Educators
organization.description: Arizona Choral Educators is the choral constituent organization of the Arizona Music Educators Association (AMEA). ACE administers the Regional Honor Choirs, the Arizona All-State Choir, the All-State Jazz and Show Choirs, the Fall Choral Festival, and the elementary/junior high choral festivals. Registration for ACE events is handled through the AMEA website.

programs.name: Arizona All-State Choir
programs.description: The Arizona All-State Choir is a choir of 200 high school students selected from the eight Regional Choirs. All Regional participants are eligible to audition. Live auditions are held in March. Selected students learn and memorize the performance songs before attending a two-day festival where they work with a nationally known clinician.

requirements.title: Selected from the eight Regional Choirs
requirements.description: The All-State Choir is drawn from the eight Arizona Regional Honor Choirs; all Regional participants are eligible to audition for All-State. Each Regional Honor Choir is made up of 100 high school students, with live regional auditions held at the end of January and a two-day regional festival in February.

requirements.title: Audition format: prepared solo (60%) plus sight reading (40%)
requirements.description: The Arizona Regional and All-State Audition consists of the performance of a required solo worth 60% of the total points, followed by a sight reading audition worth the remaining 40%. Auditions are live.

requirements.title: Sight reading practice examples published
requirements.description: ACE publishes separate Regional and All-State sight reading practice examples for audition preparation.

requirements.title: Approved editions of the required solo repertoire
requirements.description: ACE publishes Dropbox links to public-domain sheet music, accompaniment tracks, practice tracks and pronunciation videos for the solo portion. ACE states these are the approved editions of the Regional/All-State solo repertoire.

requirements.title: Memorization before the festival
requirements.description: Selected students learn and memorize the performance songs before attending the two-day festival.

requirements.title: AMEA membership required of directors
requirements.description: AMEA states its festivals are open to members only, and registration for ACE festivals is done on the AMEA site.

programs.name: All-State Jazz Choir
programs.description: The All-State Jazz Choir is part of the Arizona All-State Jazz/Show Choir Festival. It consists of two choirs, each made up of 20 high school students selected from the state. Selection is through a September audition process requiring a live singing audition. Selected students learn and memorize the performance songs before attending the festival, where they work with a nationally known jazz clinician. The festival takes place in the fall.

dates.title: ACE registration opens — Jazz/Show Choir auditions
dates.description: Listed on the AMEA calendar as an all-day event. This is the opening of registration, not a deadline; no closing date was published.

requirements.title: Live singing audition in September
requirements.description: Selection is made through an audition process in September which requires a live singing audition.

requirements.title: Memorization before the festival
requirements.description: Selected students learn and memorize the performance songs before attending the festival.

programs.name: All-State Mixed Show Choir
programs.description: Part of the Arizona All-State Jazz/Show Choir Festival. The mixed show choir is made up of 60 treble and bass singers from across the state. Selection is through a September audition requiring a live singing and dancing audition. Selected students learn and memorize the performance songs before attending a festival where they learn the choreography and refine the music.
